dc:description: One saved observed connected-minus-remaining difference, or its saved Masters-minus-research-doctorate difference of differences, per connection definition/ownership/outcome/category.
dc:title: Funding content contrasts
notes: All cells are described as lexical strings to preserve source decimal precision and codes. Parse measures using units and status fields.

A blank CSV cell alone does not identify missingness: valid blank keys, structurally inapplicable fields and unavailable values are distinguished by the dataset contract, status columns and companion JSON.
Source units and values are unchanged; the interface converts probabilities to percentages only for display.

Field bindings: source_table_id: literal catalog table ID; target_id: source.target_id; value: source.estimate_percent_or_pp; probability_difference: source.estimate_probability_or_difference; unit: source.unit; bases: source.denominator, canonical structured-cell JSON string in both formats; counts: source.numerator, canonical structured-cell JSON string in both formats; base_role: source.denominator_role; population: source.reference_population; direction: source.difference_orientation; interval_status: literal not_applicable; unavailable_reason: null for available point; source.unavailable_reason or not_provided_in_released_source for unavailable point; source_status: source.point_status; source_interval_status: source.interval_status; source_unavailable_reason: source.unavailable_reason; source_interval_reason: source.interval_reason; value_status: available for complete supplied point; otherwise unavailable; interval_unavailable_reason: literal observed_corpus_description_no_inference
Reuse terms remain source-specific; see the dataset manifest and released access notices.
